Now, if a command does not close within 1.5 seconds after receiving a stop notification upon exit, the system forcibly terminates it. Stopping a daemon no longer creates the illusion that a frozen background service has stopped, and it returns error code 1 if cleanup fails. Stopping daemons when telemetry is disabled also no longer exits silently while leaving sessions stranded on the list. Executing background commands no longer polls output files repeatedly or falls into sleep. When background sessions resume workflows, they now resume execution through the workflow tool approval mechanism.

items.original:
Fixed SessionEnd hooks sometimes not running when you exit while a background command is still running
Fixed Claude polling a background command's output file or sleeping while it runs
Fixed `claude daemon stop --any` printing "stopped" while a stuck background service kept running: it now waits, force-kills the service, and says so with exit 1 if it is still there
Fixed `claude daemon stop` exiting with no output, and leaving sessions listed as running, when telemetry is turned off
Changed exit to force-kill background commands still running 1.5 seconds after being asked to stop; in fullscreen mode they could previously be left running
Changed background sessions to resume a carried workflow through the Workflow tool's approval instead of running it from the handoff file

title.zh-TW: 工作樹修復分支定位，標籤重名不再開錯版本
title.en: Worktree Fixes Branch Resolution to Prevent Opening Wrong Versions on Tag Collisions

body.zh-TW: 大型專案常需開闢多個工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）處理不同功能，版本切換現在更加準確。⟦好似在資料庫複製多份研究分冊，以前遇到書碼長得很像的目錄卡會拿錯頁數，現在每本分冊都能精準對應到正確的原始章節。⟧以前如果分支或標籤名稱長得像提交代碼，啟動工作樹可能會切到錯誤的版本，狀態中還會出現別的分支名稱；這個辨識問題已經修好。採用新型儲存機制的專案中，分支名稱顯示異常以及無法重新開啟工作樹的錯誤已獲修正。在無法取得遠端預設分支的裸儲存庫工作樹中，會改以當前簽出的版本作為備援基準。啟動工作樹時，外掛對應的建立與移除掛鉤現在會確實執行。
body.en: Large projects often require creating multiple Git worktrees to handle different features, and switching versions is now far more accurate. ⟦Duplicating research booklets in an archive mirrors this challenge: previously, catalog cards with similar call numbers led to grabbing the wrong pages, but now each booklet maps precisely to the correct original chapter.⟧ Previously, if a branch or tag name resembled a commit hash, launching a worktree could check out the wrong version and display another branch name in the status; this identification issue is now resolved. In projects adopting modern storage backends, bugs causing abnormal branch name display and failures when reopening worktrees have been fixed. In worktrees for bare repositories unable to fetch the remote default branch, the system falls back to using the currently checked-out version as the baseline. When launching a worktree, corresponding plugin creation and removal hooks now run reliably.

items.original:
Fixed plugin `WorktreeCreate` and `WorktreeRemove` hooks not running when Claude Code starts with `--worktree` (not yet with `--tmux`)
Fixed `--worktree` sessions sometimes starting from the wrong commit when a tag or branch was named like a commit ID, and their starting git status naming a branch other than the new worktree's
Fixed the branch showing as ".invalid" and `--worktree` failing to reopen a worktree in repositories using git's reftable ref storage
Fixed `--worktree` failing in a worktree of a bare repository when origin's default branch can't be fetched; the fallback base is now the current checkout's HEAD, not the main repository's

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制重連與差異檢視修復，移除無效沙盒參數
title.en: Remote Control Reconnection and Diff Views Fixed with Dead Sandbox Flags Removed

body.zh-TW: 從網頁版或桌面版連回自己電腦操作，遠端控制的連線穩定度與檔案對照都獲得改善。⟦宛如透過遠端監視螢幕查看店鋪，以前遇到短暫訊號干擾就直接切斷畫面，貨架整修時也把撤除的櫃子當成普通移動，現在畫面呈現能如實反映現場。⟧遇到短暫的登入憑證問題時，伺服器不會直接放棄更新連線，而是會自動重試並在需要時提醒你重新登入。當同一台電腦同時提供多個連線時，正在運作的工作階段不會再被誤標為已停止。網頁與桌面端的差異檢視現在能精確分辨被刪除與更名的檔案，不再全部標成修改，並能正確呈現衝突狀態。移除了過去完全不起作用的沙盒命令列參數，若需沙盒防護請在設定檔中將 `sandbox.enabled` 設為 true。
body.en: Connecting back to your computer from the web or desktop apps now offers better connection stability and file comparison for remote control. ⟦Monitoring a storefront through a remote surveillance feed captures this improvement: previously, transient signal interference cut the display completely, and shelf reorganizations treated removed cabinets as regular moves, but now the screen faithfully reflects the floor.⟧ When encountering brief credential issues, the server no longer abandons connection renewals immediately; it retries automatically and prompts you to log in again only when necessary. When a single computer hosts multiple connections simultaneously, active sessions are no longer mistakenly marked as stopped. Diff views across web and desktop clients now accurately distinguish between deleted and renamed files instead of labeling them all as modified, and conflict states display correctly. A previously ineffective sandbox command-line parameter has been removed; if you need sandbox protection, set `sandbox.enabled` to true in your configuration file.

items.original:
Fixed the diff view in Claude Desktop and Remote Control sessions not noticing a conflicted cherry-pick or revert in reftable repositories
Fixed `claude remote-control` servers giving up on renewing their connection after a brief sign-in error, such as a locked keychain; they now retry, and warn when you need to run `claude /login`
Fixed Remote Control sessions being marked stopped while still running, on a computer serving several sessions at once
Removed the `--sandbox` and `--no-sandbox` flags from `claude remote-control`, which had no effect; passing either now exits with an error. Set `sandbox.enabled` in settings to sandbox sessions
[Remote Control] Fixed the diff view in Remote Control sessions on claude.ai and the desktop app showing deleted and renamed files as modified; requires Claude Code v2.1.296 or later on your machine

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具容錯與自動搜尋修復，斷線重連不再失效
title.en: MCP Tool Fault Tolerance and Auto-Search Fixed to Survive Reconnections

body.zh-TW: 串接外部服務最怕網路短暫重連或格式錯誤，導致整場對話直接拋出中斷。開啟自動工具搜尋時，如果 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器在中途重新連線，這項搜尋功能先前會無故關閉，修復後會持續運作。⟦彷彿接上多功能擴充座工作，以前只要其中一個外接裝置稍微晃動鬆脫重插，整排快捷鍵就會跟著失效，現在即使個別插槽訊號異常也能維持主機正常運作。⟧當外部工具規格被拒絕引發錯誤時，後續對話會改以不帶參數方式傳送該工具，避免每一輪對話都卡死在 400 錯誤。工作階段壓縮後才連線完成的伺服器，其工具與說明會立刻更新。恢復歷史對話時，也不會重複搜尋先前已經載入的延遲載入工具。
body.en: Integrating external services poses risks when brief network reconnections or formatting errors interrupt an entire conversation. When auto tool search is enabled, if an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server reconnects halfway through, search previously shut down without warning; it now remains active after the fix. ⟦Working through a multi-port docking station reflects this resilience: previously, if an external device wobbled and reconnected, the entire row of shortcuts would break, but the host now continues running smoothly even when individual slots experience signal anomalies.⟧ When rejected external tool definitions trigger errors, subsequent turns transmit the tool without parameters, preventing every turn from getting stuck on 400 errors. For servers that finish connecting after session compaction, tools and descriptions update immediately. Resuming conversation history also avoids repeatedly searching for previously loaded deferred tools.

items.original:
Fixed automatic tool search (`ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=auto`) turning off part-way through a conversation, for example while MCP servers reconnect after a resume
Fixed a conversation failing on every turn with a 400 error when the API rejected an MCP tool's input schema; Claude Code now sends that tool without parameters for the rest of the conversation
Fixed Claude not being told about an MCP server's tools and instructions until its next tool call, when the server finished connecting after a compaction
Fixed Claude searching for deferred tools already loaded earlier in the conversation when a session resumes a history that never listed them

title.zh-TW: 工作階段壓縮與記錄保存修復，斷電重啟對話不遺失
title.en: Session Compaction and Record Retention Fixed to Protect Conversations Across Reboots

body.zh-TW: 深度長對話或無頭程式執行最依賴定時摘要，避免上下文超出容量限制。在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）或 Agent SDK 中，若在回答達到字數上限或重試時觸發壓縮，重新連線可能會遺失近期待保留的訊息或摘要；這類情境已徹底修復。⟦猶如厚重的會議逐字稿定期裝訂成簡報，以前只要遇到裝訂途中紙張卡紙，前後幾頁重點就會散落遺失，現在每一份精簡摘要與關鍵頁碼都會妥善釘牢保存。⟧程式異常中斷導致對話紀錄最後一行被截斷時，重新開啟後的第一條新紀錄不再丟失。含有特殊換行符號的對話不再導致分支指令遺失訊息或清理指令略過子專案。縮小自動壓縮視窗時，壓縮指令不會再誤發高額度用量警告。本地工作階段紀錄現在會完整記錄每次請求的系統提示詞與工具參數，方便精準重現。
body.en: Deep, lengthy conversations and headless executions rely on scheduled summaries to prevent context from exceeding capacity limits. In headless mode or within the Agent SDK, if compaction triggered when answers hit length limits or during retries, reconnecting could drop recent pending messages or summaries; these scenarios have been thoroughly fixed. ⟦Binding bulky meeting transcripts into executive summaries follows a similar discipline: previously, a single paper jam during binding scattered key surrounding pages, but every concise summary and critical page reference is now securely stapled in place.⟧ When abnormal terminations truncate the final line of a conversation log, reopening no longer loses the very next log entry. Conversations containing unusual newline characters no longer cause branch commands to lose messages or cleanup commands to skip subprojects. Shrinking the auto-compaction window no longer causes compaction commands to emit false high-quota warnings. Local session logs now record system prompts and tool parameters for every request, allowing precise reproduction.

items.original:
Fixed `/autocompact` warning about high token usage when you choose a smaller auto-compact window
Fixed the first transcript entry written after resuming a session being lost when a crash had cut the transcript's last line short
Fixed `/branch` dropping messages, and `claude purge` skipping subfolder projects, when they contain a Unicode line or paragraph separator (U+2028, U+2029)
Fixed resuming a headless or Agent SDK session losing the recent messages a compaction had kept, when the compaction followed a reply cut at the output token limit (compactions from this version on)
Fixed resuming a headless or Agent SDK session losing its compaction summary or bringing back pre-compaction history, when the compaction followed a retried or unfinished reply in the same turn
Changed local session transcripts to also record each API request's system prompt, tools and parameters, so a transcript you choose to share can reproduce a request exactly

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段修復異常卡頓，容器重置後代理可繼續
title.en: Cloud Sessions Fix Freezes to Let Agents Resume After Container Resets

body.zh-TW: 雲端長任務最怕碰上伺服器重啟或政策讀取失敗，動輒卡住好幾分鐘。以前組織政策若無法讀取，雲端工作階段每輪會卡住 5 分鐘；現在會立刻結束該輪並清楚說明原因。⟦跟租用遠端辦公室的視訊會議系統一樣，以前只要網路短暫切換線路就會讓畫面凍結好幾分鐘甚至重複播放錄音，現在遇到連線阻礙能立刻標明原因並平順交接。⟧當工作階段自身的網路設定阻擋主機時，會誠實回報，不再誤稱是組織政策所封鎖。雲端容器被替換之後，曾恢復過一次的背景代理不會再被誤報為永久遺失，依舊能順利接續。修復了在長回覆期間重啟導致已回答訊息被重複執行第二次的問題。在雲端對話中送出第二則訊息後，斜線選單裡的指令說明不再集體消失。
body.en: Long-running cloud tasks face risks when server reboots or policy fetch failures freeze progress for minutes at a time. Previously, if organization policies could not be retrieved, cloud sessions stalled for 5 minutes per turn; they now terminate the turn immediately and state the reason clearly. ⟦Renting a video conference system for a remote office presents the same reality: previously, a brief line switch froze screens for several minutes or looped audio playback, but connection hurdles are now flagged with immediate reasons and handed off smoothly.⟧ When a session's own network configuration blocks the host, it reports this truthfully instead of misidentifying the cause as organization policy restrictions. After cloud containers are replaced, background agents that resumed once are no longer falsely reported as permanently lost, continuing execution normally. A bug where restarting during long responses caused completed messages to run a second time has also been resolved. Finally, command descriptions in the slash menu no longer vanish after sending a second message in a cloud conversation.

items.original:
Fixed cloud sessions telling Claude that an organization policy blocked a host when the session's own network settings did
Fixed Claude being told a background agent was lost, not resumable, after a cloud session's container was replaced, when the agent had already been resumed once
Fixed cloud sessions hanging 5 minutes per turn when the organization's policy can't be read; the turn now ends promptly and says why
Fixed a cloud session sometimes running an already answered message a second time after the session restarted during a long reply
[Cloud sessions] Fixed most commands in the / menu losing their descriptions in cloud sessions once you sent a second message

title.zh-TW: Cowork 雲端修復檔案寫入假象，改進網頁抓取與權限彈性
title.en: Cowork Cloud Fixes Phantom File Writes, Improves Web Scraping and Permission Flexibility

body.zh-TW: 在 Cowork 雲端環境指派任務，系統以前可能把本機未收到的檔案誤報為存檔成功。以前在雲端執行檔案寫入或編輯時，若指定本機路徑即使檔案根本沒傳到電腦也會顯示成功；這項假回報已修正。⟦類似把公文委託給外勤辦事員處理，以前對方把簽署文件誤存在自己的抽屜卻回報已送達你的辦公桌，現在每份檔案的遞送結果都會確實回報。⟧網頁抓取工具現在遇到剛讀取失敗的網址時，會主動告知失敗原因，不再盲目重新抓取同一網頁。當組織停用永遠允許時，連接器工具的核准提示先前漏掉了允許本次任務選項，這項回退問題已經修好。在雲端掛鉤中核准請求時，掛鉤若嘗試更動模式會被直接略過，但其餘核准項目依然有效。
body.en: When delegating tasks in the Cowork cloud environment, the system previously could misreport unreceived local files as successfully saved. Writing or editing files in the cloud with a specified local path used to show success even if the file never reached the machine; this false confirmation is now fixed. ⟦Entrusting documents to a field clerk once meant signed files could sit tucked inside a personal drawer while being reported as delivered to your desk, but now each file transfer confirms its actual delivery.⟧ The web scraping tool now explicitly explains the failure reason when encountering a freshly failed URL, rather than blindly fetching the same page again. When organizations disable allow-always, connector tool approval prompts previously missed the allow-for-this-task option, a regression that has been resolved. In cloud hooks, when an approval attempt tries to alter the mode, that modification is skipped while keeping the remaining approved items intact.

items.original:
Fixed Write, Edit and NotebookEdit in Cowork cloud sessions reporting success for a path on your own computer, where the file never arrived
Improved WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions to tell Claude that a page failed moments ago instead of fetching it again
Changed `PermissionRequest` hooks in Cowork cloud sessions: a `setMode` update in a hook's allow is now ignored; the rest of the approval still applies
[Cloud sessions] Fixed "Allow for this task" missing from Cowork's approval prompts for connector tools where an organization turns off "Always allow" (regression in 2.1.292)

title.zh-TW: 企業網關加強政策管制，修復代理伺服器與登入憑證殘留
title.en: Enterprise Gateways Tighten Policy Controls, Fixing Proxies and Residual Login Credentials

body.zh-TW: 面對公司安全檢查與網關管制的企業環境，登入憑證與連線政策的控管現在更加嚴密。⟦走進大企業的訪客發卡中心，以前換證被拒絕時訪客身上仍留著舊門禁感應卡，現在驗證未通過就會當場註銷卡片收回權限。⟧以前登入若被強制指定組織的規則拒絕，被拒組織的授權令牌（token，用來證明身分的驗證憑證）仍會殘留；現在拒絕後會徹底清除。在透過作業系統憑證庫進行 TLS 檢驗的代理伺服器後方，新功能旗標與分階段推送能正常更新，不再卡在舊版狀態。託管環境的工作階段現在會忽略設定檔裡的自訂憑證與 TLS 變數，避免覆蓋公司規定。桌面版的 Code 分頁在指定網關時會套用託管設定，啟動時必須確保網關可連線。遇到桌面端無法使用的政策鍵時，網關指令會在啟動時直接指名該鍵並中止執行，不再僅發出警告。
body.en: For enterprise environments navigating corporate security inspections and gateway controls, login credential and connection policy management is now much tighter. ⟦Stepping into a corporate badge office once meant rejected visitors might still walk away holding an old keycard, but now a failed check revokes the card and reclaims access immediately.⟧ When a login was previously rejected by a rule enforcing specific organizations, authorization tokens for the rejected organization used to linger; they are now wiped clean upon rejection. Behind proxy servers that perform TLS inspection through the operating system credential store, feature flags and staged rollouts update normally instead of getting stuck on older versions. Sessions in managed environments now ignore custom certificates and TLS variables in configuration files, preventing corporate policies from being overridden. The desktop Code tab applies managed settings when a gateway is specified, requiring a reachable gateway at launch. When encountering policy keys unsupported on desktop, gateway commands now name the offending key and abort on startup rather than merely issuing a warning.

items.original:
Fixed a login refused by `forceLoginOrgUUID` leaving the refused organization's token stored, or live after `/login`
Fixed feature flags and staged rollouts staying stale behind a TLS-inspecting proxy whose certificate is trusted only through the OS certificate store
Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST` sessions to ignore CA-bundle, tool-proxy, git TLS and git config variables like `SSL_CERT_FILE` in settings; under Claude Desktop, only in project settings
Changed Claude Desktop's Code tab to apply managed settings when `forceLoginGatewayUrl` names an Anthropic-operated gateway that serves the session's hostname; that gateway must be reachable at start
Changed `claude gateway` to stop at start, naming the key, on a `desktop:` policy key that Claude Desktop cannot use from a gateway, where it earlier started with a warning

title.zh-TW: 遙測記錄細分快取壽命，大型請求預設啟用壓縮
title.en: Telemetry Records Break Down Cache Lifespans, Enabling Compression by Default on Large Requests

body.zh-TW: 監控 API 請求花費與除錯追蹤，現在既能看清快取壽命，又能靠壓縮節省頻寬。⟦就像貨運物流單據改版，以前大包裹直接佔滿貨車空間且只蓋一個總重量章，現在先抽真空縮小體積，貨單上還清楚加註常溫與冷凍包裹的個別保存期限。⟧發往 API 的大型請求現在預設啟用 gzip 壓縮以加快傳輸，即使停用遙測也會生效；若想關閉可設定 `CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODIES=0`。遙測追蹤中加入了快取（cache，把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）壽命細分欄位，明確拆分 5 分鐘與 1 小時的寫入單位。追蹤區間全面補齊生成式 AI 標準屬性，包含供應商名稱、對話編號、工具名稱與錯誤類型。修復了在新型儲存庫安靜提交時，工具執行結果漏記 commit 代碼的問題。
body.en: Monitoring API request costs and debugging traces now provides visibility into cache lifespans while conserving bandwidth through compression. ⟦A revised shipping invoice mirrors how oversized parcels previously hogged truck space with only a total weight stamp, whereas cargo is now vacuum-compressed to save room while manifests note specific shelf lives for room-temperature and frozen goods.⟧ Large requests sent to the API now enable gzip compression by default to accelerate transfers, which remains effective even if telemetry is disabled; setting `CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODIES=0` disables it. Telemetry traces introduce breakdown fields for cache lifespan, explicitly separating 5-minute and 1-hour write units. Trace spans now populate standard generative AI attributes, including provider name, conversation ID, tool name, and error type. A bug was resolved where tool execution results omitted commit hashes during quiet commits in new-style repositories.

items.original:
Added `cache_creation_5m_tokens` and `cache_creation_1h_tokens` to the OpenTelemetry `api_request` event, splitting cache writes by lifetime
Added OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic-convention attributes to trace spans, such as `gen_ai.provider.name`, `gen_ai.conversation.id`, `gen_ai.tool.name` and `error.type`
Fixed OpenTelemetry `tool_result` events missing `git_commit_id` after `git commit -q` in repositories using reftable ref storage
Changed large requests to api.anthropic.com to use gzip compression even when telemetry is disabled; set `CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODIES=0` to turn it off

title.zh-TW: 成果物工具支援單次發布，草稿與文件路徑更完整
title.en: Artifact Tool Supports Single-Turn Publishing, Improving Draft and Document Paths

body.zh-TW: 請 Claude 撰寫長篇報告或修改程式碼成品，成果物（Artifact）的產生與微調變得更乾淨迅速。⟦如同在排版印刷工作檯前，以前校對員改一個錯字就得重新跑完一整道送件流程，現在能在同一回修改中立即蓋章出件，桌面邊條上也清楚標明原稿的完整檔案櫃位址。⟧修改成果物時，小幅度更動與重新發布現在能在單次呼叫中合併完成，較大的編輯也能在同一次回答內直接重新發布，不再分段拖延。執行成果物工具時的詳細狀態行，先前在接收輸入時會顯示無法印出路徑的代碼，現在會像終端機指令一樣清楚標示等待中與執行中。工作階段草稿記事中記錄檔案時，會直接採用完整的絕對路徑，不再使用容易造成混淆的單純檔名或相對路徑。當你在對話中提及 PDF 文件時，模型會收到更明確的提示，減少還沒閱讀內容就憑空回答的情況。
body.en: Asking Claude to write long reports or modify code deliverables is now cleaner and faster as Artifact generation and refinement improve. ⟦Standing before a typesetting bench once required proofreaders to restart an entire submission cycle for a single typo, whereas stamping and publishing now happen in the same revision alongside a full filing cabinet path clearly marked on the margin.⟧ When modifying an artifact, minor updates and republishing can now be merged in a single call, while larger edits can also be republished directly within the same response without staged delays. Detailed status lines during artifact tool execution previously displayed unprintable path codes when receiving input, but now clearly indicate waiting and running states just like terminal commands. Files recorded in session scratchpads now use full absolute paths instead of confusing standalone filenames or relative paths. When referencing PDF documents in a conversation, the model receives clearer prompts, reducing instances where it hallucinates answers before reading the content.

items.original:
Fixed the Artifact tool's verbose and ctrl+o line reading `Artifact("(unprintable path)")` while a call's input arrives; its row now shows "Waiting…" and "Running…" as Bash's does
Fixed Claude naming files in the session scratchpad by a bare filename or relative path instead of their full path
Improved the note Claude 3 models get about an @-mentioned PDF, so they less often answer without reading it
Improved artifact updates: Claude now applies a small change and republishes the artifact in one call, and makes larger edits and republishes within a single response

title.zh-TW: 終端文字對比與選單說明修復，啟動不再重複呼叫
title.en: Terminal Text Contrast and Menu Descriptions Fixed, Eliminating Duplicate Startup Calls

body.zh-TW: 各類終端機與編輯器內建面板的顯示細節，現在能看清暗淡提示且不再重複啟動檢查。在深色 ANSI 主題與 16 色終端機下，次要暗淡文字以前看起來和一般文字完全相同，難以辨識主次；現在已調好對比度。⟦跟換上清晰的儀表板燈光一樣，以前在低對比度的暗色螢幕上看所有讀數全擠成一團，現在次要說明文字有適當灰階層次，啟動車輛時也不再發出兩次引擎自檢聲響。⟧在 VS Code、Cursor 或 Devin Desktop 的內建終端機啟動時，檢查擴充套件的指令以前會重複執行 2 次，現在精簡為只啟動 1 次。沙盒選單中的選項文字由原本容易誤解的名稱改為更直觀的指令名稱。修正了說明文件在介紹限制模式參數時，誤列出已移除工具的問題。
body.en: Display details across various terminals and integrated editor panels now render dim text clearly without duplicate startup checks. Under dark ANSI themes and 16-color terminals, secondary dim text previously appeared identical to standard text, making hierarchy hard to discern; contrast has now been adjusted. ⟦Switching to clearer dashboard lighting reveals how low-contrast dark screens once blurred every gauge together, whereas secondary labels now feature proper grayscale tiers and starting the car no longer triggers two duplicate engine self-checks.⟧ When launching in the integrated terminal of VS Code, Cursor, or Devin Desktop, extension check commands previously ran 2 times, but are now streamlined to launch only 1 time. Option labels in the sandbox menu have been changed from misleading names to more intuitive command names. Documentation introducing restricted mode arguments was corrected after erroneously listing removed tools.

items.original:
Fixed `claude --help` naming a removed tool in its description of `--restricted`
Fixed starting Claude Code in a VS Code, Cursor or Devin Desktop integrated terminal launching the editor's command-line tool twice to check for the extension; it now launches it once
Fixed secondary (dim) text looking the same as normal text under the dark ANSI theme and on 16-color terminals
Changed the `/sandbox` mode options to read "Sandbox commands" instead of "Sandbox BashTool"

title.zh-TW: 自託管執行器修復輸出凍結，維持健康檢查與輪詢
title.en: Self-Hosted Runners Fix Output Freezes, Preserving Health Checks and Polling

body.zh-TW: 自己架設伺服器跑自動化任務，最怕日誌沒人讀取時整個執行器默默凍結。以前無人讀取輸出時，執行器與調度器會停止輪詢、健康檢查斷線且無法透過訊號關閉。⟦如同自動印表機接紙盤堆滿紙張，以前只要沒人抽走紙張整台機器就會罷工停機，現在會主動碎化舊紙並保留最新頁面繼續列印。⟧現在日誌會保留最新的 256 KiB 並記錄被捨棄的訊息數量，但 Windows 系統除外，讓服務始終保持運作。
body.en: Running automated tasks on self-hosted servers risks silent runner freezes whenever logs go unread. Previously, when output remained unread, runners and dispatchers stopped polling, health checks disconnected, and processes could not be shut down via signals. ⟦Piles of paper on an automated printer tray used to halt the entire machine whenever uncollected, but it now actively shreds older sheets while retaining the freshest pages to keep printing.⟧ Logs now retain the latest 256 KiB and track the count of discarded messages, excluding Windows systems, keeping services continuously operational.

items.original: Self-hosted runner: Fixed the runner and orchestrator freezing (no polls, `/healthz` or `SIGTERM` shutdown) while nobody reads their output; logs keep the latest 256 KiB and count drops (not on Windows)

title.zh-TW: VS Code 新增停用自動夾帶選取文字，修復拖曳與選單
title.en: VS Code Adds Option to Disable Auto-Attaching Selected Text, Fixing Drag-and-Drop and Menus

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 裡提問，現在能防止編輯器選取的文字被自動塞進輸入框。新增 `claudeCode.attachSelection` 設定項，設為 false 即可關閉自動夾帶。⟦好比在便條紙上抄筆記，以前筆尖畫過書頁就會自動抄進去，拖放照片也常貼錯，現在能精準只記下你想交代的事項。⟧在 Windows 下按住 Shift 拖曳檔案至輸入框時，不再插入難以辨認的磁碟機路徑，而是正確產生相對於工作目錄的參照。在 WSL、遠端 SSH 或容器環境中拖曳檔案也不再毫無反應。按向上鍵調出先前的斜線指令再按 Enter，不會再漏掉原本夾帶的參數。編輯曾標記的提示詞時，不會再被突然彈出的檔案選單遮擋。在 Windows 與 Linux 的檔案總管、其他樹狀檢視或偵錯主控台按 Ctrl+Alt+F，現在會開啟搜尋，不會再誤切換成專注檢視（Focus view）。
body.en: Asking questions in VS Code can now prevent editor-selected text from being automatically inserted into the input box. The new `claudeCode.attachSelection` setting disables automatic attachment when set to false. ⟦Jotting reminders on a notepad used to capture every passage your pen grazed across a page while misplacing dropped photos, whereas it now accurately records only the notes you intend to leave.⟧ Holding Shift while dragging files into the input box on Windows no longer inserts unreadable drive paths, correctly generating references relative to the working directory instead. Dragging files across WSL, remote SSH, or container environments is no longer unresponsive. Pressing the up arrow to recall previous slash commands and hitting Enter no longer drops original arguments. Editing previously bookmarked prompts is no longer obstructed by unexpected file menu popups. Pressing Ctrl+Alt+F across File Explorer, other tree views, or the debug console on Windows and Linux now opens search instead of erroneously toggling Focus view.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added the `claudeCode.attachSelection` setting to stop text selected in the editor from being added to your messages
[VSCode] Fixed "Edit prompt" on a flagged message opening the file or command menu over the restored prompt; Enter now sends it as written
[VSCode] Fixed Shift+dragging a file onto the prompt on Windows inserting an unreadable `/c:/…` path instead of a mention relative to the working directory
[VSCode] Fixed ↑ then Enter on a recalled slash command running it without its arguments; the command and file menus no longer open over a recalled prompt until you edit it
[VSCode] Fixed Shift+dragging a file from the Explorer or an editor tab onto the prompt inserting nothing in WSL, SSH and Dev Container windows
[VSCode] Fixed Ctrl+Alt+F toggling Focus view instead of opening Find in the Explorer, other tree views, or the Debug Console on Windows and Linux

title.zh-TW: VS Code 智慧切換思考與額度狀態，修復多重視窗鎖定
title.en: VS Code Intelligently Toggles Thinking and Quota States, Fixing Multi-Window Locks

body.zh-TW: VS Code 裡切換不同模型或重新載入視窗，最怕額度用光後請求一直卡在重送死循環。快速模式在額度耗盡時以前會持續開啟導致請求不斷被拒重送，現在會附帶錯誤提示並自動關閉。⟦就像智慧辦公桌的儀表，以前遇到儲值卡扣款不足還會一直按鈕扣款，重開機後還誤以為上一位訪客沒離開，現在能即時辨認帳戶狀態並精確清空閒置鎖定。⟧對於固定會進行深度思考的模型，介面不再顯示多餘的思考開關。對話字型大小變更現在會立即套用至差異檢視與計畫預覽，不再需要重新載入視窗，也不會被主題切換覆蓋。重新載入分頁或點擊繼續工作階段時，不會再遺失已移至工作樹的分支對話。系統在檢查其他視窗工作階段時改為直接呼叫工具，避免頻繁搜尋路徑產生額外行程。電腦在當機重開後，不會再因為行程識別碼被其他軟體重複使用而誤報對話仍在其他地方開啟。
body.en: Switching models or reloading windows in VS Code risks requests getting trapped in retry loops once quotas run out. Fast mode previously stayed on when quota was exhausted, causing requests to be repeatedly rejected and retried, but now displays an error prompt and turns off automatically. ⟦Gauges on a smart desk once kept pressing deduct buttons despite insufficient prepaid card balances and mistook previous visitors for remaining after reboots, but they now recognize account statuses instantly and clear stale locks cleanly.⟧ For models that always perform deep thinking, the interface no longer displays a redundant thinking toggle. Conversation font size changes now apply immediately to diff views and plan previews without requiring a window reload, and are no longer overridden by theme changes. Reloading tabs or clicking to resume a session no longer loses branch conversations moved to worktrees. The system now calls tools directly when checking sessions in other windows, avoiding redundant processes from frequent path searches. After a crash and reboot, the system no longer falsely reports conversations as open elsewhere when process IDs are reused by other software.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed fast mode staying on after usage credits ran out, which made each request be refused and re-sent; it now turns off until you turn it back on, with an error notice
[VSCode] Fixed the Thinking toggle switching to Off on models that always think; the toggle is no longer shown for those models
[VSCode] Fixed changes to VS Code's chat font size settings needing a window reload or being undone by a theme change; diffs and the plan preview now follow them too
[VSCode] Fixed "Resume session" and tabs restored after a reload opening an empty new conversation instead of one that had moved into a git worktree
[VSCode] Fixed the check for sessions open in other windows or terminals creating extra processes on macOS: it now starts `/bin/ps` directly instead of searching PATH for `ps` on every check
[VSCode] Windows: Fixed a conversation showing "still open somewhere else" after a crash or power loss, when Windows had since restarted and given the old process ID to another program

title.zh-TW: Slack 支援跨組織頻道，新增私人授權卡與語音讀取
title.en: Slack Supports Cross-Organization Channels, Adding Ephemeral Approval Cards and Audio Clip Reading

body.zh-TW: Slack 工作區支援跨企業共享頻道，讓跨公司協作與授權確認不必切換軟體。管理員現在可以允許 Claude 在跨企業共享的 Slack Connect 頻道中回答提問，此功能預設關閉以維護隱私；頻道原有的權限包在升級為跨組織頻道後也會持續生效。⟦走進跨公司的聯合專案討論會，以前只要外勤人員在場助理就會迴避不說話，需要批閱公文時還會當眾大喊拒絕，現在能私下遞上簽核單並自然融入多方對話。⟧當連接器工具需要授權時，討論串中會彈出僅你可見的私人卡片讓你選擇允許一次或拒絕，避免直接報錯，其他人只會看到系統正在等候你的決定。新增語音片段支援，只要 Slack 產生了文字轉錄稿，Claude 就能直接讀取內容。修復了在 Claude 自身發送的訊息下方，若有其他機器人標記它卻未獲回應的問題。
body.en: Slack workspaces support cross-enterprise shared channels, enabling cross-company collaboration and authorization checks without switching tools. Administrators can now allow Claude to respond in shared Slack Connect channels, an option disabled by default for privacy; existing channel permission bundles also remain effective after upgrading to cross-organization channels. ⟦Joining a cross-company joint project meeting used to make an assistant clam up whenever outside contractors were present and loudly shout rejections when reviewing documents, but the assistant now quietly offers sign-off sheets while blending into multilateral discussions.⟧ When a connector tool requires authorization, an ephemeral card visible only to you appears in the thread to allow once or deny instead of throwing an error, while others only see that the system awaits your decision. Audio clip support is added, enabling Claude to read contents whenever Slack generates a transcript. A bug was fixed where other bots tagging Claude under messages sent by Claude itself went unanswered.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Added support for Slack Connect channels: an Owner or Claude Tag admin can let Claude in Slack answer in channels shared with another organization; it's off by default
[Claude Tag] Added a private Allow once / Deny card in Slack threads for connector actions that need your approval, so Claude asks instead of refusing; others only see that it's waiting on you
[Claude Tag] Added support for Slack voice clips in Claude in Slack: Claude reads Slack's transcript of a clip when Slack has one
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack not answering another app that tags it in a thread under a message Claude itself posted to the channel
[Claude Tag] Changed access bundles an admin attached to a Slack channel to keep applying once the channel becomes a Slack Connect channel, with no need to remove and re-attach them

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查支援隱藏成員觸發，狀態說明直連權限設定
title.en: Code Review Supports Triggers from Private Members, Linking Status Notes to Permission Settings

body.zh-TW: 在 Pull Request 中召喚 Claude 審查程式碼，非公開成員現在也能正常觸發審查流程。以前具有寫入權限的開發者如果將自己的 GitHub 組織成員身分設為非公開，在留言中輸入 `@claude review` 常會被忽視；現在系統能正確識別權限並啟動審查。⟦就像進入管制嚴格的研發中心，以前只要名牌沒公開掛在胸前警衛就不受理申請，現在只要確認有通行卡就能啟動查核，通道封閉時也會直接告知該找哪位主管開門。⟧當儲存庫的審查功能處於暫停狀態時，留言不再引導管理員點進無關的設定首頁，而是會清楚指名有權限修復的人員，並直接附上 Git 提供者設定頁面的連結。
body.en: Summoning Claude to review code in pull requests now lets private members trigger the review workflow smoothly. Developers with write access whose GitHub organization membership was kept private previously found `@claude review` comments frequently ignored; the system now recognizes permissions accurately and launches reviews. ⟦Entering a high-security research facility once meant guards rejected requests unless badges hung visibly on chests, but verifying an access badge now initiates clearance and closed checkpoints directly name which supervisor can open the door.⟧ When repository review functionality is paused, comments no longer direct administrators to irrelevant settings landing pages, clearly naming authorized personnel instead and linking directly to the Git provider settings page.

items.original:
[Code Review] Fixed Code Review ignoring `@claude review` comments from people with write access whose GitHub organization membership is private; their comments now start a review
[Code Review] Fixed Code Review's "paused for this repository" comment sending admins to Code Review settings; it now says who can fix it and links the Git providers page

title.zh-TW: /config 支援跨類別搜尋設定，即時修改並提示重啟
title.en: /config Supports Cross-Category Setting Search, Instant Edits, and Restart Prompts

body.zh-TW: 當你想調整 Codex 的各項參數，卻記不清具體設定名稱藏在哪個分類時，現在直接輸入 `/config` 就能解決。⟦彷彿走進大型量販店使用智慧導覽機，以前要一層層貨架慢慢找商品，現在直接搜尋關鍵字就能立刻取貨，機器還會貼心提醒哪些生鮮結帳後必須馬上冷藏。⟧輸入 `/config` 後，你可以跨越不同分類快速搜尋偏好設定，支援的選項能當場修改；哪些變更需要重啟，介面也會清楚標示，不必再自己猜測設定是否需要重啟。
body.en: When you want to adjust parameters in Codex but cannot recall which category a specific setting is tucked under, typing `/config` now solves the problem immediately. ⟦Picture using a smart kiosk in a large wholesale store: previously you had to browse through aisle after aisle of shelves to find an item, but now searching by keyword lets you pick it up immediately, and the machine even helpfully reminds you which perishables must be refrigerated right after checkout.⟧ After entering `/config`, you can quickly search for preferences across different categories, and supported options can be modified on the spot. The interface also clearly indicates which changes require a restart, sparing you from guessing whether a setting demands one.

items.original: Open `/config` to search preferences across categories, change supported settings immediately, and see which changes require a restart. (#52990, #53429)

title.zh-TW: 生成中途可即時追問轉向，中斷時同步停止程式碼與工具呼叫
title.en: Steer Generations Mid-Stream with Follow-Up Prompts, Halting Code and Tool Calls on Interrupt

body.zh-TW: 看著 AI 劈頭往錯誤的方向洋洋灑灑寫下去，你不用再乾等它講完廢話才能打字糾正。⟦好比教練在場邊即時對球員大喊變更戰術，以前只能眼睜睜看著整套戰術打完才能檢討，現在哨音一響場上球員立刻改變跑位，正在熱身準備上場的替補球員也會全部停下動作。⟧Codex 正在回答的當下，你可以隨時送出後續追問來即時引導思考方向。如果你決定中斷這次回應，正在執行的 Code Mode（逐格執行程式碼的模式）儲存格會立刻停止，連同其巢狀工具呼叫也一併結束，避免背景程序白白空轉。
body.en: Watching the AI dash off in the wrong direction with paragraph after paragraph, you no longer have to wait idly until it finishes before typing a correction. ⟦Think of a coach shouting tactical changes from the sidelines to players in real time: previously you had to watch the entire play run its course before reviewing it, but now players shift positions the moment the whistle blows, while bench substitutes warming up to enter the game halt their movements as well.⟧ While Codex is in the middle of responding, you can send follow-up prompts at any time to steer its train of thought on the fly. If you decide to interrupt the response, currently executing Code Mode (a mode that executes code cell by cell) cells stop immediately, and their nested tool calls are terminated alongside them, preventing background processes from spinning in vain.

items.original: Send a follow-up while Codex is responding to steer it immediately. Interrupting a turn also stops active Code Mode cells and their nested tool calls. (#51812, #51835)

title.zh-TW: /keymap 支援自訂前導鍵，快捷鍵提示常駐且語音靜音改為 F9
title.en: /keymap Supports Custom Leader Keys, Sticky Shortcut Prompts, and Moves Voice Mute to F9

body.zh-TW: 習慣用鍵盤快速叫出各種操作的讀者，現在調整自訂按鍵更加得心應手。⟦如同樂團指揮設定了預備拍，以前比劃動作稍縱即逝容易漏看，現在提示手勢會穩穩停在空中等你接招，也把靜音操作換到另一個指定琴鍵。⟧在 `/keymap` 設定中，你可以自由配置前導鍵（按下一組按鍵後等待後續指令的引導鍵），系統預設組合為 `Ctrl+X`。按下後跳出的快捷鍵提示會持續停留在畫面上，直到你做出選擇或取消為止。語音靜音功能則移到了 `F9` 按鍵。
body.en: Readers accustomed to invoking operations swiftly via the keyboard can now customize key bindings with far greater ease. ⟦Imagine an orchestra conductor establishing a preparatory beat: previously the fleeting gesture was easily missed, but now the cueing hand rests steadily in the air waiting for your response, while the mute control is reassigned to another designated piano key.⟧ Within `/keymap` settings, you can freely configure a leader key (a guiding key that waits for follow-up inputs once pressed), with the system defaulting to `Ctrl+X`. The shortcut prompt that appears after pressing it remains on screen until you make a choice or cancel. Voice muting has been moved to the `F9` key.

items.original: Configure a leader key in `/keymap`. The default is `Ctrl+X`, shortcut hints stay open until you choose or cancel, and voice mute moves to `F9`. (#52273)

title.zh-TW: /daemon 支援重啟背景伺服器，中斷前主動警告並自動重連
title.en: /daemon Supports Restarting Background Servers with Disruption Warnings and Auto-Reconnect

body.zh-TW: 當背景執行的伺服器連線卡住或需要重載時，你不必再大費周章手動終止處理程序。⟦就像大樓總電源維護前廣播通知，以前電閘一拉整棟直接斷電，現在管理員會先警告哪些電梯與設備即將暫停，重啟完畢後還會自動幫大家把照明重新接通。⟧現在從 `/daemon` 指令就能直接重啟受管的背景伺服器（常駐在系統底層默默運作的背景程序）。重啟前，Codex 會先跳出警告，提醒這次重啟可能會中斷哪些進行中的工作。確認執行後，系統會在伺服器重啟完成時自動重新連線，省去手動重連的繁瑣步驟。
body.en: When a background server connection hangs or requires a reload, you no longer need to go through the hassle of manually killing the process. ⟦Consider a building announcement prior to main electrical maintenance: previously throwing the main switch cut power to the entire building without ceremony, but now the superintendent first warns which elevators and facilities will temporarily halt, and automatically reconnects lighting once the restart completes.⟧ You can now restart managed background servers (daemons running quietly at the system level) directly from the `/daemon` command. Before restarting, Codex displays a warning outlining which active tasks might be disrupted. Once confirmed, the system automatically reconnects as soon as the server finishes rebooting, eliminating tedious manual reconnection steps.

items.original: Restart a managed background server from `/daemon`. Codex warns about work the restart could interrupt, then reconnects automatically. (#53173)

title.zh-TW: 唯讀工具支援平行執行，技能、記憶與對話紀錄查詢不再排隊
title.en: Read-Only Tools Support Parallel Execution: Skills, Memory, and Session History Queries No Longer Queue Up

body.zh-TW: 提問時需要 AI 同時調閱多項過往資訊的讀者，現在能感受到明顯更快的查詢反應。⟦跟圖書館調派多位館員同時分頭找書一樣，以前一個人要先找完歷史檔案才能去翻閱典藏技能，現在三位館員各自朝不同書架出發，找齊資料後一口氣交到你手上。⟧Codex 現在能夠平行（同時多工處理而不依序等待）執行彼此互不干擾的獨立唯讀工具。這項機制涵蓋了擴充技能檢索、記憶調閱，以及對話歷史紀錄查詢。這些互不衝突的讀取工作現在能同步展開，縮短等待回答的時間。
body.en: Readers whose questions require the AI to retrieve multiple pieces of past information at once will now notice noticeably faster query responses. ⟦A library dispatches multiple librarians to fetch books simultaneously: where one person previously had to search historical archives before checking archived skills, three librarians now head toward separate shelves at once and deliver everything into your hands the moment it is gathered.⟧ Codex can now execute mutually independent read-only tools in parallel (processing tasks concurrently without waiting in line). This mechanism covers skill retrieval, memory lookups, and session history queries. These non-conflicting read tasks now run concurrently, cutting down the wait time for answers.

items.original: Codex can run independent read-only tools in parallel, including skill, memory, and conversation-history lookups. (#52245)

title.zh-TW: Daybreak 模型對合格帳號預設啟用，codex exec 支援金鑰指定選用
title.en: Daybreak Model Enabled by Default for Eligible Accounts, with Key-Based Selection in codex exec

body.zh-TW: 想體驗最新 Daybreak 模型的讀者，只要帳號符合資格，打開程式就能直接用上。⟦宛若高鐵會員自動升級商務車廂，以前必須特地到櫃檯出示證件申請，現在符合條件的旅客刷票進站就能直接入座，在自動售票機輸入個人憑證也能順利劃位。⟧針對符合資格的帳號，Codex 現已預設啟用 Daybreak 模型。如果你習慣使用終端機指令 `codex exec` 執行任務，在伺服器提供存取權限的前提下，只要附上 OpenAI API 金鑰（存取雲端服務的通關密鑰），也能透過該指令自由選用 Daybreak 模型。
body.en: Readers eager to experience the latest Daybreak model can now use it right out of the box, provided their account is eligible. ⟦A high-speed rail membership automatically upgrades passengers to business class: where travelers once had to present identification at the counter to apply, eligible passengers can now swipe their tickets at the gate to take their seats directly, while entering personal credentials at automated ticketing machines also secures a seat smoothly.⟧ Codex now enables the Daybreak model by default for eligible accounts. If you prefer running tasks with the terminal command `codex exec`, you can also freely select the Daybreak model through that command by supplying an OpenAI API key (the secret pass for accessing cloud services), provided the server grants access.

items.original: Daybreak is enabled by default for eligible accounts. `codex exec` can also select it with an OpenAI API key when the server offers access. (#53701, #53717)

title.zh-TW: 對話串切換支援 /side 回到分支，重啟時完整恢復授權與網路許可
title.en: Thread Switching Supports /side to Return to Branches, Fully Restoring Authorizations and Network Permissions on Reopen

body.zh-TW: 頻繁在多個任務之間切換對話串（在同一專案中分頭進行的獨立對話紀錄）的讀者，現在不用擔心進度與設定跑位。⟦有如在辦公室借調多份專案公文，以前換個案子審核印章就得重新蓋過，現在換回舊案能直接調閱已批准的用印紀錄，派出去的公文回函也會精準送回當初發文的專案夾。⟧切換對話串後，你可以隨時輸入 `/side` 指令回到先前的旁支對話。如果切換前有尚未回覆完畢的提示詞，產生的答案也會準確送回當初提問的對話串。當你重新打開已保存的對話串時，先前擁有的權限與網路存取許可都會完整還原，同時依然遵守手動覆寫與現行的管理政策。
body.en: Readers who frequently switch between threads (independent conversation logs running concurrently in the same project) no longer need to worry about losing progress or configuration state. ⟦Handling multiple project dossiers in an office setting once required restamping approvals whenever you switched cases, but returning to an earlier case now pulls up previously approved seal records directly, and replies to dispatched memos return precisely to the originating project folder.⟧ After switching threads, you can type the `/side` command at any point to return to a previous side discussion. If a prompt was still generating when you switched, the resulting response is routed accurately back to the thread where the question originated. When reopening a saved thread, your previously granted authorizations and network access permissions are fully restored, while continuing to respect manual overrides and active administrative policies.

items.original:
Resuming a saved thread restores its permissions and network approvals, while respecting explicit overrides and current managed policy. (#53150, #53419, #53424)
Return to an existing side conversation with `/side` after switching threads. Answers to pending prompts also go back to the thread that asked. (#52184, #53436)

title.zh-TW: 網路代理加強防護：DNS 查詢前先審核、阻擋重複標頭與憑證別名繞過
title.en: Network Proxy Security Tightens: Pre-DNS Query Audits, Blocking Duplicate Headers and Credential Alias Bypasses

body.zh-TW: 在需要透過代理伺服器連接外部網路的環境中，這項更新替連線安全築起了更嚴格的防線。⟦猶如機場海關加強查驗流程，以前旅客報出目的地前不會先核驗護照，現在查驗官在查詢航線前就先確認出境許可，嚴查重複填寫的申報表，也不再讓換了別名的違禁證件繞過檢查站。⟧網路代理現在會在發起網域名稱查詢（將網址轉譯為伺服器位址的查詢）前，先行檢查該連線是否具備相應權限。代理伺服器也會主動拒絕帶有重複 `Host` 標頭的請求，並防止憑證別名繞過檢查掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），杜絕未經授權的潛在連線漏洞。
body.en: In environments that route external network traffic through a proxy server, this update erects a stricter line of defense for connection security. ⟦Customs inspectors at an airport checkpoint tighten screening procedures: where officers previously did not verify passports before travelers stated their destinations, inspectors now confirm exit permits before looking up flight routes, strictly scrutinize duplicate declaration forms, and block contraband credentials disguised under aliases from slipping past checkpoints.⟧ The network proxy now verifies whether a connection holds appropriate permissions before initiating a domain name query (resolving a web address into a server destination). The proxy server also actively rejects requests bearing duplicate `Host` headers and prevents credential aliases from bypassing check hooks (small routines triggered when specific events occur), plugging potential unauthorized connection loopholes.

items.original: The network proxy now checks permission before a DNS lookup, rejects duplicate `Host` headers, and prevents credential aliases from bypassing inspection hooks. (#51650, #52661, #53506)

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援快捷鍵貼圖，WSL 剪貼簿重複讀取並防止複製卡死
title.en: Windows Gains Image Pasting Shortcuts, While WSL Reuses Clipboard Readers and Prevents Copy Freezes

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 或 WSL（Windows 系統內建的 Linux 子系統）環境下操作終端機的讀者，剪貼內容時將順暢許多。⟦恰似換了一組靈敏的櫃檯讀卡機，兩組指定快捷鍵都能把文字與圖片直接貼進視窗；頻繁讀取時能共用讀取模組，複製操作也會逾時退出，不再一直卡住。⟧在 Windows 中，`Ctrl+V` 與 `Shift+Insert` 現在都能貼上文字與圖片。而在 WSL 環境下，連續多次貼上會重複使用剪貼簿讀取器；複製操作在遇到阻礙時則會逾時退出，不再無休止地卡死畫面。
body.en: Readers running terminals under Windows or WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) will experience far smoother clipboard workflows. ⟦Upgrading to a responsive card reader at a checkout counter allows two designated shortcuts to feed both text and images straight into the window, frequent scans share the reader module, and stalled copy operations time out instead of hanging indefinitely.⟧ On Windows, both `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` can now paste text and images. Under WSL, successive pastes reuse the clipboard reader, while copy operations encountering obstacles time out gracefully rather than freezing the screen indefinitely.

items.original: On Windows, `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` paste text as well as images. On WSL, repeated pastes reuse the clipboard reader, and copy attempts time out instead of hanging. (#53224, #52967, #53453)

title.zh-TW: 指令輸出修復：本地與遠端傳輸更穩，codex exec 不再重複印出差異
title.en: Command Output Fixes: Steadier Local and Remote Transfers, codex exec Stops Reprinting Diffs

body.zh-TW: 經常在終端機執行本機指令或遠端遙控工作的讀者，這次更新修復了多項令指令卡住或資訊混亂的輸出問題。⟦宛如貨運物流中心整頓了出貨流程，以前只要下游包裝箱還沒封口，送貨司機就算卸完貨也只能在原地枯等，現在確認卸貨完成就能迅速出發，晚到的包裹也能妥善入庫而不被遺漏。⟧以前執行本機指令時，只要底層的子行程（由主程式衍生出來獨立處理任務的分支程式）沒有關閉輸出管道，整個指令就會乾等而不肯結束。現在本地指令在工作完成後能迅速結束。執行遠端指令時，晚到的輸出內容現在會妥善保留，確保最後一次輪詢時依然能完整收集。使用 `codex exec` 執行無關指令後，終端機也不會再重複印出先前的檔案差異清單。
body.en: For readers who regularly run local commands or remote tasks in the terminal, this update resolves several output glitches that previously hung commands or cluttered information. ⟦A freight logistics hub overhauls its shipping workflow: previously, as long as downstream packing crates remained unsealed, delivery drivers had to wait idly on site even after finishing unloading, but now drivers depart promptly once unloading is confirmed, and late-arriving parcels are safely warehoused rather than missed.⟧ Previously when running local commands, as long as underlying subprocesses (child processes spawned by the main program to handle tasks independently) kept output pipes open, the overall command would stall indefinitely rather than terminate. Local commands now exit promptly once their work is done. When executing remote commands, late-arriving output is now safely retained, ensuring it is fully collected during the final poll. Running unrelated commands via `codex exec` also no longer causes the terminal to reprint previous file diffs.

items.original:
Local commands finish promptly when a child keeps an output pipe open. Remote commands preserve late-arriving output so the final poll can still collect it. (#52652, #53331, #53622)
`codex exec` no longer prints the same file diff again after an unrelated command. (#53444)

title.zh-TW: 隨附技術文件更新：收錄 GPT-6 遷移指引與 Linux 沙箱架構說明
title.en: Bundled Documentation Update: GPT-6 Migration Guide and Linux Sandbox Architecture Details

body.zh-TW: 正在規劃將專案升級至新世代模型，或關注系統底層安全防護的讀者，現在能從隨附文件中查閱更詳盡的官方指南。⟦正如工廠設備手冊換上新版擴建指南，不僅詳細列出升級新型機具時的運轉特性與資料所在地考量，也公開了安全防護罩如何隔絕危險區域並過濾高壓氣流。⟧隨附的 OpenAI 文件已更新針對 GPT-6 系列模型的遷移指引，詳細說明了各模型特定的推理特性、外部工具使用方式，以及資料駐留（資料儲存與處理的地理位置）相關考量。隨附說明也進一步釐清了 Linux 沙箱機制的運作方式，詳細介紹系統如何透過 bubblewrap 達成檔案系統隔離，並藉由 seccomp 進行系統呼叫過濾。
body.en: Readers planning to upgrade projects to next-generation models or keeping an eye on low-level system security can now consult more detailed official guidance in the bundled documentation. ⟦A factory equipment manual swaps in a fresh expansion guide, not only detailing the operational characteristics and data location considerations when upgrading to new machinery, but also revealing how safety shields isolate hazardous areas and filter high-pressure airflow.⟧ The bundled OpenAI documentation updates migration guidance for the GPT-6 model family, detailing model-specific reasoning characteristics, external tool usage, and data residency (the geographic location where data is stored and processed) considerations. The bundled documentation also clarifies how the Linux sandbox mechanism operates, detailing how the system achieves filesystem isolation through bubblewrap and filters system calls via seccomp.

items.original:
Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs guidance for migrations to the GPT-6 family, including model-specific reasoning, tool use, and data residency considerations. (#51768)
Clarified how the Linux sandbox uses bubblewrap for filesystem isolation and seccomp for syscall filtering. (#52610)

title.zh-TW: 安裝包體積縮減，改用 Codex 的標準 shell 執行器並提示設定遷移
title.en: Package Size Reduced with Codex's Standard Shell Runner and Config Migration Notice

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 與 macOS 環境下安裝或更新 Codex 的讀者，這次會發現下載更輕盈且底層執行器更單純。⟦與出差輕裝上陣的概念相同，以前行李箱裡硬塞了一整套自備工具組，現在改用原有的標準工具，並把非必要的裝飾吊牌全數卸下，讓行李箱體積與重量減輕不少。⟧官方透過從安裝二進位檔中剝除符號（除錯用的內部名稱標籤），縮減了 Linux 與 macOS 版本的安裝套件體積，原始建置產物則依然保留完整符號。在執行架構上，Codex 現在改用 Codex 的標準 shell 執行器（負責執行命令的工具），不再隨附修補版的 `zsh`。如果既有設定仍包含已淘汰的 shell 標記，系統會跳出遷移通知協助你平順過渡。
body.en: Readers installing or updating Codex on Linux and macOS will find lighter downloads and a simpler underlying runner. ⟦A business traveler packs light under the same principle: rather than stuffing a custom toolkit into a suitcase, they rely on existing standard tools and strip away nonessential decorative tags, significantly reducing suitcase size and weight.⟧ The team reduced package sizes for Linux and macOS releases by stripping symbols (internal name labels used for debugging) from installation binaries, while raw build artifacts still retain full symbols. In terms of execution architecture, Codex now switches to Codex's standard shell runner (a tool responsible for executing commands), no longer bundling a patched `zsh`. If existing configurations still contain deprecated shell flags, the system displays a migration notice to help you transition smoothly.

items.original:
Codex now uses its standard shell executor and no longer bundles a patched `zsh`. Configurations using the retired shell flags receive a migration notice. (#52160, #52213)
Reduced Linux and macOS release package size by stripping symbols from packaged binaries while preserving them in the original build outputs. (#52178)

title.zh-TW: 終端機顯示多行提問不再當機
title.en: Terminal Displaying Multiline Prompts No Longer Crashes

body.zh-TW: 當你在文字視窗等待背景任務，途中跳出落落長的確認提問時，畫面不會再突然卡死關閉。以前遇到非同步提問（程式在背後運作時插進來詢問意見的對話）包含多行文字，終端機文字介面常會直接當機。這個問題現在已經修好，訊息裡的換行排版會原樣保留，附帶的超連結完整網址也不會遺失。以前常因為介面當機而看不到完整問題，現在長內容與跳轉連結都能順利讀取。
body.en: When you wait for background tasks in a text window and a lengthy confirmation prompt pops up along the way, the screen will no longer suddenly freeze and close. Previously, when asynchronous prompts (dialogues that interrupt to ask for input while programs run in the background) contained multiline text, the terminal text interface often crashed directly. This issue is now fixed, with line breaks in messages preserved as formatted and full URLs in attached hyperlinks no longer lost. While users previously often missed full questions due to interface crashes, long content and redirect links can now be read smoothly.

items.original: Fixed a TUI crash when asynchronous questions contain multiple lines, preserving line breaks and complete hyperlink destinations. (#51866)

title.zh-TW: 命令列啟動不再因背景伺服器設定不同而失敗
title.en: Command-Line Startup No Longer Fails Over Differing Background Server Settings

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣讓工具在背後持續運作，開新視窗輸入指令時，不必再擔心程式卡在開頭進不去。以前只要正在執行的背景伺服器與命令列介面（CLI，用文字指令操作的工具）預設設定不同，啟動就會報錯失敗。現在相容性檢查只會在命令列明確覆寫功能時才進行，啟動失敗的問題已經修好。以前常因預設值不同而被擋在門外，現在就算背景設定有別也能順利開啟。
body.en: If you are used to letting tools run continuously in the background, you no longer need to worry about programs getting stuck at startup when entering commands in a new window. Previously, whenever the running background server and the command-line interface (tools operated with text commands) had different default settings, startup would fail with an error. Now, compatibility checks only run when the command line explicitly overrides features, and the startup failure issue has been fixed. While users were previously locked out due to differing default values, the tool can now launch smoothly even when background configurations differ.

items.original: Fixed startup failures caused by differences between a running background server's feature settings and CLI defaults. Compatibility checks now apply only to explicit command-line feature overrides. (#52648)

title.zh-TW: 支援管理 Git 工作樹，平行開發多分支
title.en: Support for Managing Git Worktrees to Develop Multiple Branches in Parallel

body.zh-TW: 當你想在同一個專案同時開發不同功能，又不想頻繁切換分支打斷進度時，現在可以在受信任的本機專案中使用專屬工具。只要開啟工作樹功能，AI 就能直接建立並列出託管的 Git 工作樹（worktree，讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）。⟦好比在圖畫紙旁多鋪一張描圖紙，以前想畫草稿必須擦掉原本的線條，現在能同時畫兩張草圖而且隨時對照。⟧
body.en: When you want to develop different features in the same project simultaneously without interrupting progress by frequently switching branches, dedicated tools are now available in trusted local projects. Once the worktree feature is enabled, the AI can directly create and list managed Git worktrees (parallel copies of the same project managed by Git). ⟦Picture laying an extra sheet of tracing paper beside your drawing paper: whereas sketching a new idea previously meant erasing original lines, you can now work on two drafts simultaneously and cross-reference them at any time.⟧

items.original: Add tools for creating and listing managed Git worktrees from trusted local projects when the worktrees feature is enabled. (#50148)

title.zh-TW: 按鍵釘選重要任務，集中在置頂群組
title.en: Pin Important Tasks via Keystroke to Group Them at the Top

body.zh-TW: 當你在代理人的命令中心同時追蹤好幾個任務，想把當前最重要的項目固定在顯眼處時，現在只要按下鍵盤上的 p 鍵就能快速釘選。只要伺服器支援這項功能，被釘選的任務就會統一歸入共用的 Pinned 群組中，方便你隨時回頭檢視這些項目的處理進度。⟦像在辦公白板上貼便利貼，以前待辦項目一多很容易被新任務洗下去，現在能把要緊的事釘在最上方的專用區域，一眼就能看清。⟧
body.en: When tracking multiple tasks simultaneously in the agent command center and looking to keep the most critical items prominent, you can now press the p key on your keyboard to pin them quickly. As long as the server supports this capability, pinned tasks are consolidated into a shared Pinned group, making it easy to review their progress at any time. ⟦Like placing sticky notes on an office whiteboard, where a growing list of to-dos once got buried under incoming tasks, you can now pin pressing items to a dedicated top section for immediate visibility.⟧

items.original: Pin tasks in the agent Command Center with `p` and keep them in a shared Pinned group when supported by the server. (#51500)

title.zh-TW: 終端介面複製更靈活，滾輪速度隨意調
title.en: Flexible Terminal UI Copying and Adjustable Scroll Speed

body.zh-TW: 在終端介面翻看長篇對話時，如果你想快速抓出某段程式碼或重點回覆，現在的操作方式更加順手。你可以直接輸入 /copy 來選取並複製對話紀錄區塊，或是按下 Ctrl+Insert 複製目前滑鼠反白的文字。如果覺得終端介面捲動太快或太慢，還可以在設定中加入 tui.mouse_scroll_speed 調整滑鼠滾輪的捲動速度。⟦彷彿看長篇電子書時換了順手的翻頁器，以前選字複製經常受限於視窗操作，現在能精準抓取段落還能微調捲動步調。⟧
body.en: When browsing long conversations in the terminal UI, extracting specific code snippets or key responses is now much smoother. You can enter /copy to select and copy conversation blocks, or press Ctrl+Insert to copy text currently highlighted by the mouse. If the terminal UI scrolls too fast or too slow, you can also add tui.mouse_scroll_speed in the settings to adjust the mouse wheel scroll speed. ⟦Think of switching to a handy page-turner while reading a long e-book, where selecting and copying text was once constrained by window interactions, but you can now capture exact passages and fine-tune your scrolling pace.⟧

items.original: Navigate and copy transcript blocks with `/copy`, use `Ctrl+Insert` to copy selections, and tune mouse-wheel scrolling with `tui.mouse_scroll_speed`. (#50434, #50215, #50209)

title.zh-TW: 終端各類提示網址皆可點，跨行連結不中斷
title.en: Clickable Terminal Prompt URLs with Unbroken Multi-Line Links

body.zh-TW: 當 AI 在終端機跳出確認提問或警告訊息並附上參考網址時，你現在不必再手動反白複製。不論網址出現在確認標頭、提問清單、警告橫幅、驗證提示，還是 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）提示中，都能直接點擊開啟。就算網址太長被終端機自動折到下一行，連結依然能完整點開而不會斷成兩截。⟦好似在紙本書的註腳旁附上完整 QR 碼，以前長網址印成兩行容易抄錯，現在直接掃描就能連到正確網頁。⟧
body.en: When the AI displays confirmation questions or warning messages in the terminal with reference URLs, you no longer need to manually highlight and copy them. Whether a URL appears in a confirmation header, question list, warning banner, verification prompt, or an MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools) prompt, you can click to open it directly. Even if a URL is long and wrapped to the next line by the terminal, the link still opens completely without breaking in two. ⟦A printed book includes a complete QR code next to its footnotes: whereas long URLs split across two lines were once prone to copying errors, scanning directly now opens the exact page.⟧

items.original: Make URLs clickable in approval headers, questions, MCP prompts, warnings, banners, and verification prompts, including when links wrap across lines. (#51439, #51449, #51450, #51451, #51452, #51458)

title.zh-TW: 自訂模型支援聯網搜尋，可開啟遠端壓縮
title.en: Custom Models Gain Web Access and Remote Compaction Support

body.zh-TW: 如果你串接了相容於 Responses 介面的自訂模型供應商，現在能替它們啟用更多進階能力。你可以直接為這些自訂模型設定即時聯網功能（live web access），讓模型取得最新網路資訊。還可設定遠端壓縮能力（remote compaction），讓對話內容的濃縮由遠端處理。⟦如同替外聘的專家助理配置即時百科與秘書，你可以替他配上查詢新資料的工具，也可以安排秘書協助濃縮紀錄。⟧
body.en: If you connect custom model providers compatible with the Responses API, you can now enable more advanced capabilities for them. You can configure live web access directly for these custom models so they can retrieve the latest web information. You can also configure remote compaction so that conversation summaries are processed remotely. ⟦Equipping an external expert assistant with an updated encyclopedia and a secretary allows you to provide tools for looking up fresh data while also assigning a secretary to condense conversation logs.⟧

items.original: Configure live web access and remote compaction capabilities for custom Responses-compatible model providers. (#50459)

title.zh-TW: JavaScript 支援非同步串流，程式模式工具可排序
title.en: JavaScript Async Streaming Support and Ranked Tools in Code Mode

body.zh-TW: 在撰寫自動化腳本或使用程式模式（Code Mode）處理大量工具時，開發體驗得到了進一步強化。這次新增了 JavaScript 輔助工具，能在多個非同步操作（Promise）各自完成時立即串流回傳結果，不必苦等全部做完才一次收到。此外在 Code Mode 中，你還可以主動啟用排序工具搜尋功能，讓系統依照關聯度推薦最合適的工具。⟦跟外送點餐即時收到每道菜出餐通知一樣，以前得等整桌菜炒完才送上來，現在哪道先好就能先拿到並更快找到餐具。⟧
body.en: When writing automation scripts or handling numerous tools in Code Mode, the development experience is further enhanced. New JavaScript helper utilities now stream results back immediately as multiple asynchronous operations (Promise instances) complete individually, without waiting for every task to finish. Furthermore, in Code Mode, you can actively enable ranked tool search so the system recommends the most relevant tools by relevance. ⟦Food delivery orders send real-time alerts as each dish leaves the kitchen: instead of waiting for the entire table of dishes to be cooked before serving, you receive each item as it is ready and locate utensils much faster.⟧

items.original: Add JavaScript helpers for streaming promise results as they settle, plus opt-in ranked tool search in Code Mode. (#51126, #51209)

title.zh-TW: 終端對話遵循預設模型，保留手動指定參數
title.en: Terminal Sessions Follow Default Models While Preserving Manual Overrides

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟新的終端對話時，系統現在會優先採用伺服器端設定的模型與推理摘要預設值。以前新建對話可能忽略伺服器給定的預設配置，現在系統會完整遵循這些預設選項。假使你在啟動時手動傳入了特定參數，系統也會優先保留你明確指定的覆寫值，不會被預設設定強行蓋過。⟦宛若走進連鎖餐廳用餐，以前廚房常搞錯標準配方，現在預設會照標準菜單出餐，但也依然遵循你點單時註明的客製需求。⟧
body.en: When starting a new terminal conversation, the system now prioritizes server-configured defaults for models and reasoning summaries. Whereas creating a new conversation previously could ignore default server settings, the system now adheres fully to these defaults. If you manually pass specific parameters at launch, the system also prioritizes and retains your explicit override values instead of overwriting them with defaults. ⟦Dining at a chain restaurant illustrates the change: while the kitchen previously could mix up standard recipes, it now serves according to the standard menu by default while still honoring any custom preferences specified on your order.⟧

items.original: Respect server model and reasoning-summary defaults for new TUI threads while retaining explicit launch overrides. (#50013, #50811, #50913)

title.zh-TW: 套用補丁保留換行格式，Windows 檔案不跑版
title.en: Patch Application Preserves Line Endings Without Corrupting Windows Files

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境下修補程式碼時，你不再需要特地手動指定設定來維持原本的換行格式。以前執行 apply_patch 更新檔案時，若未額外開啟選項，既有的 CRLF（Windows 標準換行符號）可能會被改掉；現在 apply_patch 會自動保留檔案原有的換行格式。這個問題已經修好，能避免檔案送出版控時多出整份換行差異。⟦跟維護舊文件一樣，以前每次送出修訂都得額外勾選保留原本排版，否則換行符號會被洗掉；現在直接套用也能原樣留存。⟧
body.en: When patching code in Windows environments, you no longer need to manually specify settings to preserve original line endings. Previously, updating files with apply_patch could alter existing CRLF line endings (the standard Windows line-ending format) unless an extra option was enabled; apply_patch now automatically preserves the file's original line endings. This issue is resolved, preventing unintended diffs across the entire file when committing changes to version control. ⟦Maintaining legacy documents once required ticking an extra box on every revision to keep original formatting from getting overwritten, but applying edits now preserves line endings automatically.⟧

items.original: Preserve existing CRLF line endings in `apply_patch` updates without requiring an opt-in. (#51203)

title.zh-TW: Linux 沙箱啟動防護強化，嚴格落實檔案隔離
title.en: Enhanced Linux Sandbox Startup Protections and Enforced File Isolation

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 環境中使用安全沙箱隔離執行環境時，系統修復了多項攸關啟動與檔案存取的安全限制。當設定了多個禁止存取的檔案時，沙箱以前可能無法順利啟動，現在啟動流程已修復。沙箱現在會拒絕可被寫入的建構執行檔。也修正了 ripgrep 設定，確保搜尋配置不會削弱禁止規則（deny-glob）的檔案遮罩防護。⟦就像保險庫修好了門禁名單一多就卡住的問題，也拒用能被改動的門禁安裝工具，並讓查找物品的設定不會削弱禁止存取的名單。⟧
body.en: When using the security sandbox to isolate execution environments on Linux, the system fixed several security constraints related to startup and file access. The sandbox previously could fail to start when multiple denied files were configured, but this startup process is now fixed. Sandboxes now reject writable executables used to construct the sandbox. The ripgrep configuration was also corrected to ensure search settings do not weaken deny-glob file mask protections. ⟦A bank vault fixes a stall that occurred whenever access denial lists grew too long, rejects modifiable installation tools, and ensures search settings never undermine restricted lists.⟧

items.original: Fix Linux sandbox startup with multiple denied files, reject writable sandbox-construction executables, and keep ripgrep configuration from weakening deny-glob masks. (#50059, #51211, #51407, #51527)

title.zh-TW: Windows 10 磁碟存取恢復，沙箱暫存權限一致
title.en: Restored Windows 10 Drive Access and Consistent Sandbox Temp Permissions

body.zh-TW: 如果你在 Windows 10 系統上執行指令或使用沙箱隔離環境，先前遇到的路徑找不到與權限錯誤已獲得修復。現在恢復了一般磁碟代號（如常見的 C 槽與 D 槽）檔案存取能力，讀寫既有檔案不再出錯。Windows 沙箱內的暫存目錄權限也調整為與子行程（subprocess，由主程式啟動的附屬運作程序）環境一致，避免程式在執行時因權限不符而卡住。⟦有如拿到了相符的門禁卡，以前在 Windows 10 容易讀不到磁碟或被暫存目錄擋在門外，現在權限一致後各項操作都能順利通行。⟧
body.en: If you run commands or use sandboxed environments on Windows 10, previously encountered missing path and permission errors are now resolved. Standard drive letter file access (such as common C: and D: drives) is restored, preventing errors when reading or writing existing files. Permissions for temporary directories inside the Windows sandbox are also aligned with environments of subprocesses (child processes started by the main program), preventing programs from hanging due to permission mismatches during execution. ⟦Obtaining a matching keycard resolves previous hurdles on Windows 10 where drives were unreadable or temp directories locked you out, ensuring all operations proceed smoothly with consistent permissions.⟧

items.original: Restore ordinary drive-letter file access on Windows 10 and match Windows sandbox temp permissions to the child process environment. (#51511, #51512)

title.zh-TW: 遵循伺服器建議時間重試
title.en: Retrying Requests Following Server Recommendations

body.zh-TW: 使用 Codex 時，送出的請求或即時連線若失敗，你可能需要等一段時間才能重試。Responses（傳送模型請求的介面）的可重試失敗，現在會遵循伺服器的 Retry-After 建議。這個標頭會告訴用戶端應等待多久再試。WebSocket（維持雙向即時通訊的連線）的可重試失敗也適用：依照建議時間等待後再重試。⟦好比撥打客服電話遇到忙線，聽到語音建議稍後再撥，就依照建議等候，再重新撥打。⟧
body.en: When using Codex, if a sent request or real-time connection fails, you may need to wait for a while before retrying. Retryable failures for Responses (the interface for sending model requests) now follow the server's Retry-After recommendation. This header tells the client how long to wait before trying again. Retryable failures for WebSocket connections (which maintain two-way, real-time communication) also follow this rule by waiting for the suggested duration before retrying. ⟦When dialing a busy customer service line, a caller follows the automated voice prompt to wait for the suggested time before calling back.⟧

items.original: Honor server `Retry-After` advice for retryable Responses and WebSocket failures. (#50418, #51440)

title.zh-TW: Windows 安裝程式附帶數位簽章，版本下載更安全
title.en: Windows Installers Include Digital Signatures for Safer Version Downloads

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 下安裝或更新系統時，安裝腳本與版本下載機制現在具備更高的安全性與相容性。Windows 發行版本現在附帶已簽署的 PowerShell 安裝程式。當環境中存在 PowerShell 7 模組路徑時，舊版透過 Windows PowerShell 安裝可能發生的壓縮檔校驗碼驗證失敗問題也已修好。下載管理方面，系統現在能防止舊版或預覽版本意外覆蓋較新的穩定版下載目標與安裝別名。⟦猶如官方包裹附上可核對來源的簽名，以前可能誤把舊包裹拿來替換新品，現在不會了。⟧
body.en: When installing or updating the system on Windows, installer scripts and version download mechanisms now offer higher security and compatibility. Windows releases now include a signed PowerShell installer. When PowerShell 7 module paths exist in the environment, archive checksum verification failures that previously occurred when installing through Windows PowerShell are now fixed. For download management, the system now prevents older or preview versions from accidentally overwriting newer stable download targets and installation aliases. ⟦Receiving an official package with a verifiable signature ensures that old parcels are no longer mistakenly used to replace brand-new items.⟧

items.original:
Fix archive checksum verification when installing through Windows PowerShell with PowerShell 7 module paths present. (#51257)
Publish a signed PowerShell installer with Windows releases. (#51158)
Keep older stable releases and prereleases from replacing newer stable download targets or installer aliases. (#51186, #51425)

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 在 daemon 模式下能正常顯示對話紀錄
title.en: Remote Control Displays Conversation History Properly in Daemon Mode

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣將工具以 daemon（在背景持續運作的服務）模式啟動，再透過 Remote Control 遠端操控介面查看進度，可能曾遇過找不到過去紀錄的狀況。以前在這種背景情境下，Remote Control 不會顯示先前的對話紀錄。現在這個問題已經修復，在 daemon 模式下對話紀錄會正常顯示。
body.en: If you usually launch the tool in daemon mode and check progress through the Remote Control interface, you might have run into cases where past records could not be found. Previously in these background scenarios, Remote Control did not display prior conversation history. This issue has now been fixed, and conversation history displays properly in daemon mode.

items.original: Fixed conversation history not showing in Remote Control in daemon mode.

title.zh-TW: agy plugin validate 擴充檢查範圍，把關技能、子代理與規則設定
title.en: agy plugin validate Expands Check Coverage to Guard Skills, Subagents, and Rule Configurations

body.zh-TW:
打包套件最怕設定缺漏。現在 `agy plugin validate` 會把關技能、子代理與規則。⟦跟遠行清單一樣，以前只看外觀，現在連證件效期都逐項核對，有疏失立刻示警。⟧

`SKILL.md` 缺標頭（frontmatter，檔首宣告）會報錯；缺 `name`、`description`、資料夾名不符、逾 24 KB 或同名略過則警告。

子代理標頭錯誤、缺欄位、`agent.json` 解析失敗或用保留名報錯；重複名稱、無標頭檔或被忽略的 `agent.json` 則警告。

規則標頭無效或缺 `trigger` 報錯（略過 `README.md`）；缺描述、`globs`、逾 24 KB 或根目錄誤放 `AGENTS.md`、`GEMINI.md` 則警告。
body.en:
Nothing is worse when packaging plugins than missing configuration settings. Now `agy plugin validate` guards skills, subagents, and rules. ⟦Like a travel checklist, it previously only inspected luggage exteriors, but now it verifies document expiration dates item by item and flags any oversight immediately.⟧

A missing `SKILL.md` frontmatter triggers an error. Missing `name` or `description`, folder name mismatches, exceeding 24 KB, or skipped duplicate names trigger warnings.

Subagent frontmatter errors, missing fields, `agent.json` parsing failures, or using reserved names trigger errors. Duplicate names, files without frontmatter, or ignored `agent.json` files trigger warnings.

Invalid rule frontmatter or a missing `trigger` triggers an error (skipping `README.md`). Missing descriptions, missing `globs`, exceeding 24 KB, or mistakenly placing `AGENTS.md` or `GEMINI.md` in the root directory triggers a warning.

items.original: Improved `agy plugin validate` to also check a plugin's skills, subagents, and rules: for skills, it errors on a `SKILL.md` with missing or invalid frontmatter and warns when `name` or `description` is missing, when `name` doesn't match its folder, when the body is over the 24 KB limit, or when a skill in `skills/` is skipped because an earlier skill has the same name; for subagents, it errors on an `agents/` Markdown file with invalid frontmatter or a missing `name` or `description`, an unparseable `agent.json`, or a name reserved for a built-in agent, and warns on duplicate agent names, Markdown files in `agents/` without frontmatter, and `agent.json` files, which the CLI ignores; and for rules, it errors on a rule with invalid frontmatter or without a valid `trigger` (skipping a `README.md` in `rules/` without frontmatter), and warns on a `model_decision` rule without a `description`, a `glob` rule without `globs`, content cut to fit the 24 KB limit, or an `AGENTS.md` or `GEMINI.md` at the plugin root instead of in `rules/`.

title.zh-TW: 檔案行內差異預覽對齊檢視樣式，支援語法高亮與增刪襯色
title.en: Inline File Diff Previews Align with Inspection Styling, Supporting Syntax Highlighting and Tinted Changes

body.zh-TW:
收到代理人請求編輯或建立檔案的確認提示時，你現在能在對話區直接看清每一處改動細節。行內差異預覽（inline diff preview，在對話中直接顯示檔案修改對照的畫面）現在對齊 `/diff` 檢視風格，支援當前配色方案的語法高亮。⟦如同在合約草稿上使用雙色螢光筆批註，以前確認改動只有單調的黑白純文字，現在新增與刪除的行別會以專屬襯色清晰標記，行號欄也保持乾淨不被色彩干擾。⟧

新渲染方式為新增與刪除的程式碼行加上背景襯色。若選用 `Terminal` 配色方案，介面會根據終端機的淺色或深色背景，挑選對比最適當的底色。

畫面左側的行號欄則維持無襯色，避免色塊延伸到邊欄而干擾視線，讓你審查程式碼時更容易對齊行數。
body.en:
When you receive confirmation prompts from agents requesting to edit or create files, you can now see every modification detail directly in the conversation. Inline diff previews (screens showing file modifications directly in the conversation) now align with the `/diff` inspection style and support syntax highlighting for the active color scheme. ⟦Picture annotating a contract draft with two-color highlighters: confirming changes previously relied on monotonous black-and-white plain text, but added and deleted lines are now clearly marked with dedicated tints, while the line number column stays clean and free from distracting color.⟧

The new rendering method adds background tints to added and deleted code lines. If the `Terminal` color scheme is selected, the interface selects the most suitable contrast tint based on whether the terminal background is light or dark.

The line number column on the left side of the screen remains untinted, preventing colored blocks from bleeding into the margin and distracting your gaze, making it easier to track line numbers during code reviews.

items.original: Improved the inline diff preview when the agent asks to edit or create a file so it renders like the `/diff` file view, with syntax highlighting for your color scheme, background tints on added and removed lines (picked from your terminal's light or dark background when using the `Terminal` color scheme), and an untinted line-number gutter.

title.zh-TW: 終端機渲染機制調整，降低打字與執行時的 CPU 消耗
title.en: Terminal Rendering Adjustments Reduce CPU Consumption During Typing and Execution

body.zh-TW:
頻繁在終端機輸入長篇文字或等待背景運算時，你的電腦不會再莫名感受到風扇狂轉的散熱壓力。現在提示區在每個影格只渲染一次，跨影格時也會直接重用未變更文字列的測量寬度。⟦好比翻閱逐格動畫冊，以前每翻一頁就把整面黑板全擦乾淨、逐字重新測量重寫，現在沒變動的段落直接保留，動態跑馬燈也整段套色，不再一個字一個字慢慢畫。⟧

底端的動態狀態列（status line，終端機底端提示執行進度的橫列）過去是一次渲染一個字元，現在改為依相同樣式區段批次繪製。

排版優化減少了重繪時的重複計算，使你在終端機打字或等待回覆時的 CPU 使用率顯著降低。
body.en:
When frequently typing long passages into the terminal or waiting on background computations, your computer will no longer endure spinning cooling fans from thermal strain. The prompt area now renders only once per frame and reuses measured widths of unchanged text rows across frames. ⟦Think of flipping through an animation flipbook: previously, every page turn wiped the entire chalkboard clean to remeasure and rewrite character by character, but unchanged sections are now retained directly, and dynamic banners are styled as entire spans rather than drawn slowly glyph by glyph.⟧

The dynamic status line (the bar at the bottom of the terminal displaying execution progress) previously rendered one character at a time, but now batches rendering by identically styled segments.

Layout optimizations reduce redundant computations during redraws, noticeably lowering CPU usage while typing in the terminal or waiting for responses.

items.original: Improved CPU usage while typing and while the agent is working by rendering the prompt area once per frame, reusing measured line widths for unchanged rows across frames, and rendering the animated status line in styled runs instead of one character at a time.

title.zh-TW: 企業帳號鎖定遙測為關閉，初次設定移除一般遙測勾選框
title.en: Enterprise Accounts Lock Telemetry Off, Removing Consumer Telemetry Checkbox from Initial Setup

body.zh-TW:
如果你平時使用企業帳號或 Google Cloud 專案登入工具，設定介面現在會明確反映資料隱私政策。企業帳號與透過 `AGY_ADC_AUTH` 登入的環境本就絕不收集提詞、檔案內容或模型回覆，但先前在 `/config` 設定選單裡，遙測開關（telemetry，軟體回傳診斷與使用數據的機制）卻仍處於可切換狀態。⟦就像公務用車配有不可關閉的資安規格，以前面板開關還能隨意撥動讓人困惑，現在直接固定在關閉檔位並貼上說明，交車時也不再附上一般民眾的意向調查表。⟧

現在 `/config` 中的 `Enable Telemetry` 列已改為顯示 `off (disabled)`，並附帶文字說明鎖定原因。

初次執行並透過 `AGY_ADC_AUTH` 初始化設定時，畫面僅會顯示 Google Cloud Platform 服務條款，直接移除一般消費者的遙測授權核取方塊。
body.en:
If you routinely log in using an enterprise account or a Google Cloud project, the settings interface now explicitly reflects data privacy policies. Enterprise accounts and environments authenticated via `AGY_ADC_AUTH` never collect prompts, file contents, or model responses in the first place, yet the telemetry toggle (a mechanism transmitting diagnostic and usage metrics) remained switchable inside the `/config` settings menu. ⟦Consider an official fleet vehicle equipped with non-toggleable security standards: previously, the dashboard switch could be toggled at will to everyone's confusion, but it is now locked in the off position with an explanation attached, and delivery no longer includes an optional consumer survey form.⟧

The `Enable Telemetry` row in `/config` now displays `off (disabled)` accompanied by text explaining the reason for the lock.

During initial launch and configuration setup via `AGY_ADC_AUTH`, the screen displays only the Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service, outright removing the standard consumer telemetry consent checkbox.

items.original: Fixed `Enable Telemetry` in `/config` remaining editable for Business accounts (such as Google Cloud project and Application Default Credentials sign-in via `AGY_ADC_AUTH`), where prompts, content, and model responses are never collected: the row now shows `off (disabled)` and explains why, and first-run setup with `AGY_ADC_AUTH` now shows the Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service without the consumer telemetry opt-in checkbox.

title.zh-TW: 舊版 Windows 遇沙盒限制改為執行前確認，設定面板隱藏不相容選項
title.en: Older Windows Falls Back to Pre-Execution Prompts Under Sandbox Limits, Hiding Incompatible Settings

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 10 或尚未升級至 24H2 的 Windows 11 電腦上操作時，指令執行不再因為作業系統缺少沙盒支援而動彈不得。以前若在此類系統選取了沙盒權限模式，終端機隔離防護（terminal sandbox，將指令限制在受控邊界內執行的安全環境）會因環境不支援而導致代理人指令啟動失敗。⟦與遊樂設施的安全門檢驗相似，以前遇到感測器規格不符的舊閘道會直接卡死鎖上，現在設施會自動切回人工驗票口，購票面板也不再列出無法支援的感應手環選項。⟧

現在命令列會自動關閉終端機沙盒，啟動備援措施，改為在執行各項指令前先跳出確認提示。

遠端控制（Remote Control）在瀏覽器中的設定彈窗，也會直接在此類系統上隱藏沙盒權限選項，避免誤選無效設定。
body.en:
When operating on Windows 10 or Windows 11 PCs not yet upgraded to 24H2, command execution will no longer stall because the operating system lacks sandbox support. Previously, selecting sandbox permission mode on such systems caused terminal sandboxing (a secure environment confining commands within controlled boundaries) to fail during agent command startup due to lack of environment support. ⟦Just as an amusement park ride manages safety gates, older turnstiles with incompatible sensors previously locked up completely, but the attraction now falls back to a manual ticket gate and removes unsupported wristband options from the ticket kiosk.⟧

The command line now automatically disables the terminal sandbox and activates a fallback, prompting for confirmation before executing each command instead.

The Remote Control settings popover in the browser also hides the sandbox permission option on such systems, preventing accidental selection of invalid settings.

items.original: Fixed agent commands failing to start on Windows versions that don't support the terminal sandbox (Windows 10 and Windows 11 before version 24H2) when a sandboxed permission mode was selected: the CLI now turns off the terminal sandbox and falls back to asking before running commands, and the Remote Control browser Settings modal hides sandboxed permission options on those systems.

title.zh-TW: 網路斷線改為自動重試，筆電休眠或換網不再中斷工作
title.en: Network Disconnections Trigger Automatic Retries, Keeping Work Intact Across Laptop Sleep and Network Switches

body.zh-TW:
帶著筆電在不同會議室間移動，或是闔上螢幕喚醒電腦後，交給代理人執行到一半的任務不會再輕易中斷。以往當系統碰上網路連線端點（socket，程式之間建立連線傳輸資料的介面）斷線，例如筆電休眠或切換 Wi-Fi 後觸發的 `broken pipe`、`software caused connection abort`、`network is down` 或 `http2: client connection lost`，對話會直接以錯誤訊息終止。⟦遇上長途通話訊號不穩時，以前只要路過隧道斷訊一瞬間電話就直接被掛斷，現在通話軟體會先在背景自動重新撥號嘗試接回，真的連不上才會跳出撥打失敗的警示。⟧

現在工具遇到此類斷線錯誤時，會在背景自動展開重新連線重試。

只有在重試依然無法建立連線時，代理人才會回報網路錯誤，不再因為短暫的網路波動而拋棄整輪進度。
body.en:
When moving a laptop between conference rooms or waking it after closing the lid, tasks handed off to the agent will no longer easily abort midstream. Previously, when the system encountered network socket disconnections (interfaces establishing connections to transfer data between programs)—such as `broken pipe`, `software caused connection abort`, `network is down`, or `http2: client connection lost` triggered after laptop sleep or switching Wi-Fi—the conversation terminated outright with an error. ⟦During an unstable long-distance phone call, passing through a tunnel previously dropped the line the moment the signal cut out, but calling software now redials automatically in the background to reconnect, displaying a call failure alert only when connection truly fails.⟧
